mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS decline over 3 months falls below 0.03 in any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in periods of declining FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.5% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.5% in 3 months, or the Rank IC for the UNRATE threshold condition is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate a broad-based economic slowdown in both demand and supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect between HOUST and INDPRO (measured by the product term) has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or negative returns do not occur in more than 60% of instances where both series decline.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL above 5.0% annually), the Federal Reserve is expected to tighten monetary policy, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances during high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 5.0% annually), or the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL in high inflation regimes is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over the past quarter signals strong economic growth that boosts corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for GDPC1 growth over the past quarter falls below 0.03 in any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in periods of rising GDP.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1600 thousand units in a 3-month window, it indicates a weakening housing market that reduces consumer spending and business investment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances when HOUST is below 1600, or the Rank IC for the HOUST threshold condition is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Weak labor market growth (PAYEMS below 0.5% monthly) combined with rising interest rates (FEDFUNDS above 1.5%) signals reduced consumer spending power and higher borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect between PAYEMS and FEDFUNDS (measured by the product term) has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or negative returns do not occur in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS growth is below 0.5% and FEDFUNDS is above 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In supply shock regimes (INDPRO below 95.0), manufacturing output contraction reduces corporate production capacity and increases input costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances during supply shock regimes (INDPRO < 95.0), or the Rank IC for INDPRO in supply shock regimes is below 0.03.
